observed.caption: Indoor souvenir shop aisle lined with white display shelves holding wooden animal carvings, patterned stools, and hanging Africa map banners.
observed.description: White metal A-frame display shelves line both sides of a tiled aisle inside a covered shop with a corrugated metal roof and fluorescent tube lighting. The left shelves hold dark polished wooden sculptures of lions, rhinoceroses, leopards and other animals on the upper levels, small round stools painted with zebra stripes and giraffe spots on the middle level, and rows of dark wooden figurines and carved cattle groups on the lower level. Colorful fabric banners hanging from the ceiling show maps of Africa, and a large orange and red tapestry depicting a savanna sunset with zebras, acacia trees and birds hangs in the background. The right shelves display numerous small animal figurines, beaded crafts, and hanging masks. The floor is white tile with grey marble veining, and white support beams and additional hanging textiles are visible overhead.
